svg.title: Occupancy prediction framework diagram reconstructed as editable SVG
svg.desc: Inventory and conduction summary: the figure contains five aligned base regions: T-frame surround-view images at top-left, a green top pipeline region with image encoder, D2-VFormer, R2-EFormer, OCC decoder and occupancy prediction, a pink Depth Cues region containing MoGe-2 and derived depth products, a blue D2-VFormer region containing image features, voxel pooling, sparse voxel features and depth-guided voxel refinement, and an orange R2-EFormer region containing occupancy semantic feature, recursion block and full-region voxel feature. Origins were established per frame at the upper-left major object; content was conducted rightward and downward from those origins. Symmetry/equipartition basis: the overall figure is divided into left/middle/right functional columns, with repeated cubes and vertical arrows aligned on common center lines.

g.desc: Top-left frame inventory: a multi-camera surround-view collage with a car at center, labels It and It-1 to It-4, and a lower caption. The collage is the origin; labels are conducted around it.
Green pipeline origin: image encoder trapezoid at left. Rightward conduction reaches D2-VFormer label, a semantic cube, R2-EFormer label, OCC decoder, a white arrow and an occupancy prediction map.

Depth Cues origin: MoGe-2 rounded box. Downward conduction includes depth encoder/decoder, a large down arrow, depth feature thumbnail, surround-view depth image thumbnail, pseudo point cloud, depth occupancy grid, curved projection arrows and bottom title.

Blue D2-VFormer origin: image feature thumbnail below the top encoder. Conducted downward to voxel pooling, voxel encoder and sparse voxel cube; conducted rightward to depth-guided refinement and densification, then to the right output arrow.

Orange R2-EFormer origin: occupancy semantic feature cube at the top. Conducted downward through dashed vertical connections to the recursion block, then through arrows to the full-region voxel feature cube and the bottom title.
